summary: Markdown lazily loads pulldown-cmark WebAssembly and keeps the shared HTML policy on JavaScript fallback; inline HTML closing tags use remark's whitespace grammar so malformed closers cannot release hidden content, balanced autolink parentheses keep their destination, long labels and resource references scan linearly without discarding text, diff headers count hunk content correctly, and tests isolate both parsers

replay.detail: Web UI only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: Web UI only; no wire, protocol, runtime or client changes.
